finding.text: Ask 1, duplicate-bubbles, came first in the brief, and the owner hit it again today. Nothing in the diff fixes it: there are only probe scripts (`dup-e2e.mjs`, `count.mjs`, `peek.mjs`, `padwav.mjs`). There is also no `STATE.md` in the task folder giving a cause or a blocker, so the "Reproduce first, fix the cause" ask is neither met nor recorded.

Two "Done when" items are missing from the diff: `ux/Dictate/doc/asks.md` has no new commit links (line 48 still reads "not re-run after tonight's changes"), and there is no `STATE.md`. The last line of `task.jsonl` says docs, merge, the batched restart and the walk/smoke run are still "next", so this is a review of unfinished work.

In `public/framework/ext/Refine/stages/CardsStage.js:10-23`, the new `sent`/`send` block was put between `weight()` and its doc comment ("How much of what you said this card covers…"). That comment now sits above `sent = {}` and describes the wrong member. Move the block above the comment.

The "To board" button depends on `this.prompt.session`. `VoiceFlow.js:622` sets it only when a prompt is first created, and only from `this.session`, which `follow()` sets. Any prompt read before `follow()` runs in `AISessionDetail.js:538` (after `load_row` resolves), and any VoiceFlow that never calls `follow()`, keeps `session` undefined. That button can only say "Retry: this page does not know its session". Simpler: have `send()` read the session from the flow at click time.

`Servex/ext/refine/CardAsk.js:136-143` has a race. Two presses at the same moment (or the same card on two tabs) both pass the `known` check, so two board cards get made. `asks.add` then refuses the second id without telling anyone, which leaves an orphan card. A per-id in-flight map in CardAsk would close this.

In `Servex/agents/Echo.js:75-81`, if `clean()` or `structure()` throws, the stages already written stay on screen at "Cleaning"/"Structuring" forever, and `voice.done()` never runs. Run's own path marks a failure. Echo should do the same in a catch/finally.

`CardsStage.js:574` builds the `prompt` sent to the server from `this.prompt.id.replace(/^voice-/, "")`. `CardAsk.make` accepts it only if it matches `^[\w-]{4,60}$`. Refine ids (`t…`) and Echo ids (`"t" + base36 time`) both pass, so this is fine. It only works because the formats happen to match, though, and nothing states that contract.

`public/framework/ext/Refine/stages/files.jsonl:681-683` adds `things.json`, `ThingsIndex.mjs` and `ThingsStage.js`. Those files have nothing to do with this task. They do exist, so this is probably a census catch-up, but it should be its own commit.

The pieces that were built look correct and are simple. The whisper SSE route takes the runner once and unhooks it on close (`Servex.js:41-49`), and `whisper()` makes the runner only once, so the listener is never stale. `Asks.add` refuses a duplicate id. `LiveClean` is opt-in, and its cost comes from measured `RefineCall.sink`. In `VoiceStrip.js`, the 5 s poll is replaced by the stream, with `recover()` kept as the fallback.

per-sentence-model-clean was asked as "cheap"; what was built costs about $0.07 a sentence, so it ships opt-in and off (STATE.md §5, asks.md). That is reported honestly with the reason, but the owner's "cheap" is not met yet: the next step is to cut the per-call cost (a fresh session per call), as asks.md says.

duplicate-bubbles was not reproduced, so no fix was made. The brief allows this ("or in STATE.md with the real blocker"), and `dup-e2e.mjs` is left as the check to run. The word repeated across a chunk seam (STATE.md §1) is a real lead and deserves its own line in asks.md "Open", not just a mention.

The brief asks for a layout check at 400/1200/1920/3440. The new **To board** button (CardsStage.js:43-48, VoiceStage.css:703) is a page change, but STATE.md records no layout check, and this review was given no shots. On a narrow card the "Retry: Servex is not reachable" label could wrap the footer row.

Servex/ext/refine/run.js:274 `spent()` reads the static `RefineCall.sink`. Two refines running at the same time swap that one global, so one card's cost can include the other's calls. This already affected `runs` before this change; the fix is per-run storage (AsyncLocalStorage).

Servex/ext/refine/CardAsk.js:156-160 creates the board card first and writes the ask line second. If the ask write fails, nothing records the card, so the next press makes a second board card. Also, `words` is set to a session URL, but elsewhere in the ledger that field holds the owner's own words.

Servex/Servex.js:45-49: the whisper stream subscribes to the `whisper` process object at connect time. That is fine today, because `whisper()` makes it once at boot, but if Whisper is ever re-created the page goes quiet with no error. VoiceStrip.js:817 counts "stopped" and "errored" as down, but `Connection.line` (Connection.js:755) has no sentence for them, so the status line shows an error with no reason.
Simpler: AISessionDetail.js:594 `voice.session = session_id` repeats what `VoiceFlow.follow()` now does itself (VoiceFlow.js:669), so the line can go.

One-off scratch scripts are committed in the task directory (`count.mjs`, `peek.mjs`, `padwav.mjs`), and CLAUDE.md says scratch belongs in the scratchpad. ui-proof.mjs:534 also defaults to a worktree-only port (51720). Separately, `ext/Refine/stages/files.jsonl` picked up three census lines for files this task did not touch (STATE.md "Left" names this).
